title: Users
content: The Users page lets you view, filter, and manage everyone who has access to your clinic's mGrape account — from Admins and Managers down to individual Users.

title: Open Users
content: Click here to open the Users page.

title: User Filters
content: Filter the user list by role or branch to quickly find the person you're looking for. Use Reset Filters to return to the full list.

title: User List
content: All registered users for your hospital appear here with their role, branch, and account status. Admins can invite new users, resend invites, and manage access directly from this panel.
